title: Why I personally don't use Workflows in Microsoft Agent Framework

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today is going to be a bit different, because this is about some of the things I don't use in the Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 今天有點不同，要談談我在 Agent Framework 裡不使用的某些功能，

cues.en: and particularly around the workflows, because I simply cannot see why they are needed.
cues.zh: 尤其是工作流程，因為我目前真的看不出為什麼需要它。

cues.en: There might just be me, it might just be my scenarios, but every time I try to use a workflow,
cues.zh: 也許只是我個人的想法，或是我的使用情境如此，但每次嘗試工作流程時，

cues.en: I end up writing some regular code that is much simpler.
cues.zh: 最後都會改成更簡單的一般程式碼。

cues.en: So, and it is a big part of the Agent Framework, at least the name says it's the agent part that is
cues.zh: 工作流程確實占了 Agent Framework 很大一部分；不過從名稱來看，至少代理程式本身才是，

cues.en: an important part,
cues.zh: 重要的部分。

cues.en: but we have this entire workflow, agentic workflows and so on, but I just don't see the value in them.
cues.zh: 現在還有整套工作流程、代理式工作流程等功能，但我個人還看不到它們的價值。

cues.en: And again, it might be me, I would very much like an open discussion in the comments about this, because I want to see the light, but I haven't.
cues.zh: 也許是我的問題，很歡迎在留言中公開討論。我希望能理解，但目前還沒有。

cues.en: And for that reason, let me show you some of the arguments and some examples I have made.
cues.zh: 因此，接下來會分享一些理由，以及我寫的範例。

cues.en: So, let's jump in.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: And I have made various videos on this.
cues.zh: 我之前其實已經做過各種相關影片。

cues.en: I've made sequential workflows, concurrent workflows, handover workflows.
cues.zh: 包含循序工作流程、並行工作流程，以及交接工作流程。

cues.en: I've done a human-in-the-loop, I've made the AI-assisted, where we are more manual in our workflows.
cues.zh: 也做過人員介入，以及比較偏手動編排的 AI 輔助工作流程。

cues.en: I've looked at group chat and simply just threw it away, because there was no value in it.
cues.zh: 我研究過群組對話，但最後放棄，因為看不出實際價值。

cues.en: And also, I've looked at all the samples from Microsoft themselves, and there's samples,
cues.zh: 也看過 Microsoft 自己的全部範例；它們確實是範例，

cues.en: but there's no real business value in my book.
cues.zh: 但在我看來，沒有呈現真正的商業價值。

cues.en: So, it's not like I don't want to do stuff in sequence, but it's more cumbersome to do it in a workflow like this.
cues.zh: 不是說我不想循序執行工作，而是用這種工作流程寫法反而比較繁瑣。

cues.en: And I know there's things about being able to checkpoint it and resume it and all these kinds of things.
cues.zh: 我知道它支援檢查點、恢復執行等功能。

cues.en: Again, the kind of things I do don't take that long.
cues.zh: 不過我的工作通常不需要執行那麼久。

cues.en: If a workflow runs for like five minutes, it's a long...
cues.zh: 如果跑到五分鐘，已經算很長了……

cues.en: An AI task runs for five minutes, and probably so are yours.
cues.zh: AI 任務執行五分鐘就算長，你的任務可能也是如此。

cues.en: So, again, I'm not saying that you can't use workflows, but I've also heard from a lot of people that just want to use workflows for workflow's sake,
cues.zh: 再次強調，我不是說不能使用工作流程；但我聽過不少人只是為了使用而使用，

cues.en: and I think that's wrong to do.
cues.zh: 我認為這不是好的理由。

cues.en: That's the main part of this video, because let's see a concurrent...
cues.zh: 這就是這支影片的重點。我們先看並行……

cues.en: No, let's start with sequential. This is the simplest one.
cues.zh: 不，先從最簡單的循序流程開始。

cues.en: And I made an example back in the day where we took a summary agent and a translation agent
cues.zh: 之前我做過一個例子，使用摘要代理程式與翻譯代理程式，

cues.en: and took some legal text and then let it first summarize it and then translate it.
cues.zh: 把一段法律文字先摘要，再翻譯。

cues.en: So, putting those two agents in sequence.
cues.zh: 也就是把兩個代理程式依序串接。

cues.en: And we can do that, and we can see we'll use 62 lines of code, and we need to do this streaming and turn token and watch for the events in order to get them out.
cues.zh: 可以用工作流程做到，但需要 62 行程式碼，還得處理串流、TurnToken，以及監聽事件來取出結果。

cues.en: And this is an object, so we need to know to turn it into a list of chess matches and so on.
cues.zh: 結果是 object，還必須知道怎麼把它轉成 ChatMessage 清單等型別。

cues.en: So, it can certainly be done, but up here I have the exact same kind of code for sequential.
cues.zh: 當然做得到，但上方也有完成完全相同循序工作的程式碼。

cues.en: And it's even taking up a bit extra here, because I need a namespace and stuff, because I put it into a subclass.
cues.zh: 甚至因為放進另一個類別，需要命名空間等內容，還多占了一些篇幅。

cues.en: But I do exactly the same up here. We can't save in setting up here.
cues.zh: 前面的初始化完全一樣，這裡沒辦法省略。

cues.en: But then I just go in and take my summary agent, run async, get the response back, get my messages,
cues.zh: 接著只是呼叫摘要代理程式的 RunAsync，取得回覆與訊息，

cues.en: and then take my translation and take the output of the summary response, and then we're done.
cues.zh: 再把摘要結果傳給翻譯代理程式，就完成了。

cues.en: This is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 做的事情完全相同。

cues.en: So, this is essentially the code I'm replacing with this code here.
cues.zh: 也就是用這裡的程式碼，取代下面那整段。

cues.en: There, this couldn't appear.
cues.zh: 原本這麼多內容，現在只要這些。

cues.en: It is no objects at all. It's just pure strongly typed all the way.
cues.zh: 而且不必處理 object，全程都是強型別。

cues.en: Very, very simple to understand.
cues.zh: 非常容易理解。

cues.en: So, if I were to ever do sequential, I would do this.
cues.zh: 所以如果需要循序執行，我會採用這種方式。

cues.en: Let's look at concurrent.
cues.zh: 再看看並行。

cues.en: So, concurrent is nice sometimes if you have enough tokens to do it.
cues.zh: 如果 Token 額度足夠，並行有時確實很有用。

cues.en: But in this case, it was just, again, a legal text with a legal agent and a spelling error, which would probably not run concurrent anyway.
cues.zh: 不過這個範例仍然是法律文字，由法律代理程式與拼字檢查代理程式處理，實際上可能也不適合並行。

cues.en: But if they could run concurrent, I have very few times where things can run concurrent like that
cues.zh: 即使可以，我也很少遇到真的能這樣並行的情境，

cues.en: because they need each other when they are in a kind of workflow.
cues.zh: 因為流程中的步驟通常會彼此相依。

cues.en: But again, we can do some of the same, and we get these, again, the in-process execution and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 不過這裡一樣可以使用 InProcessExecution 等工作流程機制。

cues.en: And if we look up in a version of that, we have, again, exactly the same start.
cues.zh: 再看一般程式碼版本，前面同樣完全相同。

cues.en: We can't change that.
cues.zh: 初始化部分無法改變。

cues.en: But then I will just use a task when all started to agents, and then when I get both back, just write out my for each.
cues.zh: 但之後只要用 Task.WhenAll 啟動兩個代理程式，等兩個都完成，再用 foreach 輸出。

cues.en: Give exactly the same results, and these three, four lines of code
cues.zh: 結果完全相同，只需要這三、四行程式碼，

cues.en: takes away all this very hard to understand and debug as well.
cues.zh: 就能取代那些難以理解、也難以除錯的程式碼。

cues.en: So, why not just these three lines of code?
cues.zh: 那為什麼不直接用這三行？

cues.en: Why put in an entire workflow for such simple things?
cues.zh: 這麼簡單的事情，為什麼需要整套工作流程？

cues.en: And I know it's simple scenarios here, but even if it's more advanced,
cues.zh: 我知道這些情境很簡單，但即使更複雜，

cues.en: I would just put it out in various classes and have them run it in a simple flow.
cues.zh: 我也會把邏輯拆成不同類別，再用簡單的流程執行。

cues.en: And of same situation, we get some three different agents, an intent agent, and a movie agent, and a music agent,
cues.zh: 接著是交接情境：有意圖判斷、電影與音樂三個代理程式，

cues.en: and we need to have the intent agent pass it on to or hand it off to someone, the others.
cues.zh: 由意圖代理程式判斷，應該把問題交給哪一個。

cues.en: There we begin to make these with hands-off that this one can send it to these ones, and these ones can send it back to this one, and such things.
cues.zh: 工作流程寫法需要設定交接關係：這個能交給那些，那些又能交回這個。

cues.en: And then we make our workflow run where we need to send the events
cues.zh: 再執行工作流程，處理事件，

cues.en: and find the right person talking, and all these kinds of things.
cues.zh: 找出目前是哪個代理程式發言等細節。

cues.en: So, if we do that, we can either do it by tools, so we can just set up the same agents, but instead the intent agent
cues.zh: 但也能改用工具：一樣建立這些代理程式，只是讓意圖代理程式，

cues.en: also get two tools, which are the two other agents, and then we just ask, and then we are basically done.
cues.zh: 把另外兩個代理程式當成工具，然後直接詢問，基本上就完成了。

cues.en: If we want to see what agent it calls, it's not necessary.
cues.zh: 如果想觀察它呼叫哪個代理程式，這不是必要的，

cues.en: We put in a little function called middleware, but beyond that,
cues.zh: 只要加上一個小型函式呼叫中介軟體即可。

cues.en: we are down to these few lines of code compared to all this.
cues.zh: 除此之外，這幾行就能取代下面整段。

cues.en: And I simply don't understand why people want to sit and write things like this because there's no reuse.
cues.zh: 我不太理解，為什麼要花時間寫這種工作流程，因為沒有增加重用性。

cues.en: That was one of my things.
cues.zh: 這也是我原本的期待之一。

cues.en: I thought in the beginning that it couldn't make things be more reusable.
cues.zh: 一開始我以為它能讓程式更容易重用。

cues.en: I've not seen the scenario.
cues.zh: 但我沒有看過這樣的情境。

cues.en: I've simply not seen the scenario, and again, code is very reusable in general in C Sharp in general.
cues.zh: 真的沒有，而且 C# 程式碼本來就能做得很容易重用。

cues.en: But this is how we could do it with just tools, but we could also do it with structured output in a much more similar fashion.
cues.zh: 剛才是把代理程式當工具，也可以用結構化輸出達成很類似的效果。

cues.en: We just make our agents again, and then we just use structured output to get out the type of question.
cues.zh: 一樣先建立代理程式，再透過結構化輸出判斷問題類型。

cues.en: Is it a movie question or a music question?
cues.zh: 是電影問題，還是音樂問題？

cues.en: Then a switch case on that and write out with full control, with nothing making our run async for us
cues.zh: 接著用 switch case，直接呼叫並輸出，全程自己掌控，不必讓框架代為執行 RunAsync，

cues.en: so we can not control anything or anything.
cues.zh: 導致我們難以控制細節。

cues.en: So very simple to do.
cues.zh: 所以做法非常簡單。

cues.en: Human little loop. Let's have a look.
cues.zh: 再看看 Human-in-the-loop。

cues.en: For the human little loop, we need to make some agents, find the animal to guess.
cues.zh: 這個例子要先建立代理程式，選擇要猜的動物。

cues.en: This is a small guessing game.
cues.zh: 這是一個簡單的猜謎遊戲。

cues.en: We find an animal to guess and give some hints, and then we make our request port so we can get human little loop interventions,
cues.zh: 選好動物、提供提示，再建立 RequestPort，才能讓人員介入，

cues.en: and we need our executor down here where it takes the input, which is the guess.
cues.zh: 下方還要有執行器，接收使用者的猜測。

cues.en: If it's not the right one, then give a new hint, else say the game is over.
cues.zh: 如果猜錯，就再給提示；猜對則表示遊戲結束。

cues.en: And up here we need to go start our event and listen for all these various things.
cues.zh: 上方還需要開始執行，並監聽各種事件。

cues.en: So it's possible again, but if we look in just normal code, we do exactly the same up here.
cues.zh: 同樣可以做到；但如果只是一般程式碼，前面的設定完全一樣。

cues.en: But then we just make a while loop in this case or however you want to have your GUI, of course, and then we just take our guess.
cues.zh: 之後只要寫一個 while 迴圈，或配合你的 GUI 寫法，再取得使用者猜測。

cues.en: If the answer is right, break the loop, else give a new hint.
cues.zh: 答案正確就跳出迴圈，否則再給提示。

cues.en: We're saving lines of code, and it's much more simple to understand this code, in my book at least.
cues.zh: 不但減少程式碼，我認為也更容易理解。

cues.en: And the most strong example is the pizza example.
cues.zh: 最明顯的例子，是披薩範例。

cues.en: So if we look at the pizza example down here where we use the executors.
cues.zh: 先看下方使用執行器的披薩工作流程。

cues.en: So if we go in here, then we need to make an order parser, and the order parser gets an AI
cues.zh: 我們必須建立 OrderParser，裡面使用 AI，

cues.en: to do structured output on that.
cues.zh: 進行結構化輸出。

cues.en: So in here we just do this, but we need to have all this ceremony above and below for almost nothing.
cues.zh: 真正的工作只有這一點，卻需要上方與下方那一整套格式與結構。

cues.en: The stock taker is just checking through the various toppings of the order and check if the mushroom is out of stock sample here
cues.zh: 庫存檢查器只是遍歷訂單配料，像這裡判斷蘑菇缺貨，

cues.en: and put it into a warning.
cues.zh: 再加上一則警告。

cues.en: And the success executor then says the pizza is okay, and the other one will say it is not okay
cues.zh: 成功執行器只表示披薩沒問題，另一個則表示無法完成，

cues.en: and send a mail to the customer.
cues.zh: 並寄信給顧客。

cues.en: And then we need to build the workflow, we need to build the edges, and we need to build the switch so it switches between the end success or the warning part of it.
cues.zh: 接著建立工作流程、定義邊與 Switch，判斷要進成功分支還是警告分支。

cues.en: Have the workflow run and react to the various events in it.
cues.zh: 最後執行並處理各種事件。

cues.en: We look at that without a workflow.
cues.zh: 再看不用工作流程的版本。

cues.en: We simply just go and say the input.
cues.zh: 只需要先取得輸入。

cues.en: We take our order agent and give us back an order.
cues.zh: 交給接單代理程式，取得訂單。

cues.en: We immediately loop over that and make some warnings.
cues.zh: 直接遍歷配料，產生警告。

cues.en: We check if there's warnings.
cues.zh: 檢查有沒有警告。

cues.en: If not, it says okay, else the other is not okay.
cues.zh: 沒有就表示可以製作，否則表示有問題。

cues.en: Up here I'm using the same objects down here, so we'll still need to have the objects and the creation of the agents, but the flow of this is so much simpler
cues.zh: 這裡使用的物件與下方相同，因此仍然需要那些物件與代理程式初始化，但流程本身，

cues.en: in my book to understand.
cues.zh: 我認為容易理解得多。

cues.en: So then some of you might argue, okay, what if you get a very, very complex workflow?
cues.zh: 有人可能會問，如果工作流程非常複雜呢？

cues.en: Well, then I would probably use a workflow engine like N8n, Logic Apps, Make,
cues.zh: 那我可能會使用 n8n、Logic Apps、Make 等工作流程引擎，

cues.en: all these that are actually good for that with very complex setups, and then I will build small entries into an API that could help with the scenarios
cues.zh: 這些系統擅長處理複雜編排，再把需要 AI 的部分做成小型 API，

cues.en: that the workflow engine couldn't do by itself, because then I have that someone else takes care of running the workflow, saving all the workflow data and so on.
cues.zh: 補足引擎本身做不到的情境，讓引擎負責執行與保存流程資料等工作。

cues.en: I don't want to store all that because even now we can do workflows and we can save how they went and so on.
cues.zh: 我不想自己儲存所有這些資訊；即使目前框架能執行工作流程、保存過程，

cues.en: We still would need to build something that could show these workflows executions and so on.
cues.zh: 仍然得自己建立顯示工作流程執行結果的介面。

cues.en: So there I would outsource it to a real workflow engine system.
cues.zh: 所以這種情況，我會交給完整的工作流程引擎。

cues.en: And then if I have the need, but again, this is simple code.
cues.zh: 但如果只是這類需求，程式碼本身很簡單。

cues.en: Yes, there are some if statements.
cues.zh: 沒錯，裡面有一些 if。

cues.en: Ooh, that's scary. That's wrong.
cues.zh: 難道有 if 就很可怕、很不對嗎？

cues.en: Or yes, it can break in the middle.
cues.zh: 又或者，有人說程式可能執行到一半中斷。

cues.en: Yes, the others can also break in the middle, and yes, there is some robustness in there to build in, but in reality, I don't see them happening.
cues.zh: 其他方式也可能中斷；確實可以額外加強穩健性，但我的情境裡很少遇到需要那些功能的情況。

cues.en: But that's for the comments of this video.
cues.zh: 這就留給影片留言討論。

cues.en: Tell me how I'm wrong.
cues.zh: 請告訴我哪裡想錯了。

cues.en: Tell me why I'm wrong.
cues.zh: 也說明為什麼。

cues.en: Tell me what you use your workflows for because there is a reason why this YouTube series has not shown workflows so much
cues.zh: 告訴我你使用工作流程的情境。這個 YouTube 系列很少介紹工作流程，是有原因的。

cues.en: because, again, every time I try to find, oh, yes, now I have my bank statement, which I made a video on, on how to balance my banking book.
cues.zh: 因為每次我以為找到好案例，例如之前拍過的銀行對帳與帳務核對，

cues.en: Yes, then I could use concurrent to both check for the dividend company
cues.zh: 一開始覺得可以同時查詢發放股息的公司，

cues.en: and match the output or the PDF.
cues.zh: 以及比對輸出或 PDF。

cues.en: But then suddenly I couldn't do that because I needed something from the dividend before I could actually find the PDF.
cues.zh: 但後來又發現，找到 PDF 之前，需要先取得股息相關資訊，所以根本不能並行。

cues.en: And just every time there's something that turns out to be, yes, yeah, this cannot be concurrent or, yes, I'm using so many tokens
cues.zh: 每次都會遇到類似情況：不是無法並行，就是 Token 用量太大，

cues.en: that concurrent would just lead to rate limits or, yeah, I could do this, but it would add me 50 lines extra of code
cues.zh: 並行只會碰到速率限制；又或者雖然可以做，卻多出五十行程式碼，

cues.en: or complexity to look at it.
cues.zh: 以及額外的理解負擔。

cues.en: So I can't see why workflows need...
cues.zh: 所以我看不出為什麼非得使用工作流程。

cues.en: I understand why they are there.
cues.zh: 我理解它為什麼存在。

cues.en: I can live with them being there, but please, sometimes you just need to write good code instead of trying to fit it into a workflow
cues.zh: 也不反對保留這項功能，但有時候只需要把一般程式碼寫好，不必硬塞進工作流程，

cues.en: just because they're there.
cues.zh: 只是因為框架提供了它。

cues.en: So that's my message, but also my question to you.
cues.zh: 這是我的想法，也是想請教大家的問題。

cues.en: Tell me why I'm wrong with this video.
cues.zh: 請告訴我這支影片有哪些地方不對。
